description:
Setwork — Set your work. Get it done ●
Your tasks live on your phone. Not in a cloud.
Setwork is a distraction-free task manager that works entirely offline. No account. No sync fees. No ads. Just you and your to-do list.
Why people love it:
● Open it. Add a task. Done. No onboarding, no setup wizard.
● Smart reminders that let you in sync.
● Notes alongside tasks, so context never gets lost.
● App modes, theming, customizations — your app, your feel.
Built lean. Runs fast. Respects your privacy completely.
